Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `checkout` in namespace `shop` rolled out revision 2 (ReplicaSet `checkout-7f6bb97849`, change-cause "release v2"), whose container command exits 1 when `/etc/checkout/config.yaml` is missing and whose pod template mounts no config volume, so pod `checkout-7f6bb97849-bhfbm` crash-loops.

EVIDENCE:
1. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod checkout-7f6bb97849-bhfbm` (diag-k8s): container `checkout` is Waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff; Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 1; Restart Count 5. Command is `sh -c "echo checkout v2 starting; echo FATAL: config file /etc/checkout/config.yaml not found >&2; exit 1"`. Mounts show only the service account token, with no config volume.
2. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop checkout-7f6bb97849-bhfbm --previous` (diag-k8s): `checkout v2 starting`, then `FATAL: config file /etc/checkout/config.yaml not found`.
3. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop rs -l app=checkout -o custom-columns=...` (diag-k8s; I re-ran it and confirmed): `checkout-658d6f85b4` is REVISION 1, CHANGE-CAUSE "release v2", DESIRED 0. `checkout-7f6bb97849` is REVISION 2, CHANGE-CAUSE "release v2", DESIRED 1, READY `<none>`. Revision 2 changed only the command; the image (`busybox:1.37`) is the same.
4. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp` (diag-k8s): `ScalingReplicaSet` "Scaled down replica set checkout-658d6f85b4 from 1 to 0"; pod `checkout-7f6bb97849-bhfbm` has reason BackOff, "Back-off restarting failed container checkout". Revision 1 previously ran with command `sh -c "echo checkout v1 serving; sleep 36000"`. The events show it was Created and Started, not a READY=1 reading.
5. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop deploy checkout -o yaml` (diag-k8s): annotation `deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "2"`; Available=False, reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable; `unavailableReplicas: 1`. The template has no volume for `/etc/checkout`.

FIX (not applied): roll `checkout` back to revision 1 (`kubectl --context kind-sre-lab rollout undo -n shop deploy/checkout --to-revision=1`), or ship a config volume that provides `/etc/checkout/config.yaml` for revision 2.

Fact.Name: what changed
Fact.Value: revision 2 (`release v2`) changed the command; revision 1 ran

Fact.Value: roll back to revision 1 (`kubectl rollout undo deploy/checkout`) or ship the config
